'''Carlos Bernia Return to Classics''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Carlos Bernia]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-6561">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6561 Return to Classics], DeckTech (Carlos "Talon Karde" Bernia, 11 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6561/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6561/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018173121/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6561/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Carlos Bernia]]
* '''Published:''' 11 May 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Return to Classics''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: Guest Quarters|CC-L-cloudcityguestquarters.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Don't Tread On Me|SE-L-donttreadonme.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor CCGQ Bernia LS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits Rebel Lightsaber: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' A lot of main Characters, their weapons, their ships, interruputs and a few sites. The Characters of ligth side are very powerful well used.

The post names no Defensive Shields.

The post also lists 1x Rebel Lightsaber, which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.

== Original post ==

'''Return to Classics'''
* '''Author:''' Carlos "Talon Karde" Bernia
* '''Published:''' May 11, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' A lot of main Characters, their weapons, their ships, interruputs and a few sites. The Characters of ligth side are very powerful well used.

=== Strategy ===

It's very easy to play, play the main Characters in Space or in Ground and begin drain as soon as possible. Interrupts an effects are to protect them or to bring them a lot of destiny. This deck have a good average of destiny, I obtain a total dest. of 19 only with the Millenium F. Capt. Solo, Luke & Punch It, this battle make me win the play and go down with the Executor and two pilots without any problem. Try it and Good luck.
